reasons.text: This batch removes the last active Exchange Online (Plan 2) assignment, carried by group Firm Staff (e2b7c9d4-1a5f-4d3e-8b6c-9f0a1e2d3c4b). The mailbox stays shared but goes over its 50 GB quota at 62 GB.
reasons.consequence: Exchange team blog: when the license is removed from a converted shared mailbox over 50 GB, the 50 GB quota is enforced, sending and receiving stop, and incoming mail fails with "Mailbox is full", code 5.2.2.
reasons.remediation: Assign Exchange Online (Plan 2) independently of the group, confirm the assignment is Active, then check again. Or bring the mailbox under 50 GB, then check again.
